newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom launches new cellular package.
newsitem.headline: Telecom launches new cellular package.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand on Thursday launched a new consumer cellular package, 025 To Go, which offers a choice of two cellular call plans with the aim of making mobile communications more convenient and affordable.
The Go Easy plan offered a NZ$15 monthly access fee and off- peak per minute charges of 20 cents locally and 40 cents nationally. Peak calls cost NZ$1.80.

The Go Free plan, developed for customers who make a lot of off-peak calls, has a NZZ$29.95 monthly access fee with 200 minutes of free calling per month. Per minute charges are 15 cents for local calls and 40 cents for national calls. Peak
